articles.title_en: Regular Research ArticleGlobalization and gender equality
articles.title_cn: 常规研究文章全球化与性别平等
articles.abstract_en: Highlights•Globalization is linked to greater gender equality, mainly driven by actual global interactions (de facto) rather than trade policies (de jure).•We find the strongest positive effects in lower-income countries, suggesting globalization fosters gender equality in developing nations.•A one-standard-deviation rise in globalization is associated with a 12.1% increase in legal gender equality.•Micro- and country-level data align, indicating globalization shifts social norms toward more pro-female attitudes.•Policies should focus on real global engagement, as de facto globalization matters more than trade agreements.AbstractLegal rights continue to differ between women and men, particularly in developing countries. In this paper, we examine whether economic integration can improve gender equality by law. We design a novel instrumental variable strategy based on regional waves of globalization, which serve as strong exogenous predictors of national globalization trends. Our main estimate suggests that an increase of one-third in the globalization index, equivalent to a permanent transition from Indonesia to the United States, is associated with a 12.1 and women are treated equally by law. We also find that this effect is almost entirely driven by de facto globalization. Linking globalization to more than 300,000 individuals from about 100 countries, we provide evidence for a microfoundation of the macroeconomic effects.
articles.abstract_cn: 要点•全球化与更高的性别平等相关，主要由实际全球互动（事实上的）而非贸易政策（法律上的）驱动。•我们发现低收入国家的正面效应最强，表明全球化促进发展中国家的性别平等。•全球化指数每上升一个标准差，与法律性别平等提高12.1%相关。•微观和国家层面数据一致，表明全球化将社会规范转向更支持女性的态度。•政策应关注实际的全球参与，因为事实上的全球化比贸易协定更重要。摘要法律权利在女性和男性之间仍然存在差异，尤其是在发展中国家。在本文中，我们考察经济一体化是否能通过法律改善性别平等。我们设计了一种基于全球化区域浪潮的新型工具变量策略，这些浪潮作为国家全球化趋势的强外生预测因子。我们的主要估计表明，全球化指数增加三分之一，相当于从印度尼西亚永久过渡到美国，与12.1相关，且女性在法律上受到平等对待。我们还发现，这一效应几乎完全由事实上的全球化驱动。将全球化与来自约100个国家的超过300,000个体联系起来，我们为宏观经济效应的微观基础提供了证据。

articles.title_en: Regular Research ArticleThe role of technology in reducing the gender gap in productivity
articles.title_cn: 常规研究文章技术在缩小生产力性别差距中的作用
articles.abstract_en: Highlights•Female-managed firms are less productive, with larger gaps in lower-income economies.•Female- and male-managed firms adopt digital technologies equally.•Female-managed firms use less sophisticated sector-specific technologies.•Female-managed firms gain higher returns from technologies, reducing productivity gaps.•Technology gaps link to differences in managerial quality and government support.AbstractA growing body of literature documents productivity differences between male- and female-led businesses in developing countries. This paper examines these gaps through the lens of technology adoption. Using novel firm-level data from the World Bank’s Firm-level Adoption of Technology surveys, we measure differences in productivity and technology adoption between male- and female-managed firms. The results show that female-managed firms tend to adopt similar levels of technology sophistication in general business functions, but they lag in the adoption of more advanced sector-specific production technologies. We also find that female-managed firms achieve higher productivity gains from adopting advanced technologies, partially offsetting initial gaps. An Oaxaca–Blinder decomposition indicates that differences in managerial quality, access to government support, and sectoral composition account for part of the adoption gap. These findings underscore the role of technology adoption as a potential channel for narrowing gender-based productivity differences in developing economies.
articles.abstract_cn: 亮点•女性管理的企业生产力较低，在低收入经济体中差距更大。•女性和男性管理的企业采用数字技术的程度相同。•女性管理的企业使用较不复杂的特定行业技术。•女性管理的企业从技术中获得更高的回报，缩小了生产力差距。•技术差距与管理质量和政府支持的差异有关。摘要越来越多的文献记录了发展中国家男性和女性领导的企业之间的生产力差异。本文通过技术采用的视角来考察这些差距。利用世界银行企业技术采用调查的新颖企业层面数据，我们衡量了男性和女性管理企业在生产力和技术采用方面的差异。结果表明，女性管理的企业在一般业务功能中倾向于采用相似水平的技术复杂性，但在采用更先进的特定行业生产技术方面落后。我们还发现，女性管理的企业从采用先进技术中获得更高的生产力收益，部分抵消了初始差距。Oaxaca-Blinder分解表明，管理质量、政府支持获取和部门构成的差异解释了部分采用差距。这些发现强调了技术采用作为缩小发展中经济体基于性别的生产力差异的潜在渠道的作用。

articles.title_en: Regular Research ArticleOpportunistic behavior and discrimination in the mexican solar photovoltaic market: An audit experiment
articles.title_cn: 常规研究文章墨西哥太阳能光伏市场中的机会主义行为与歧视：一项审计实验
articles.abstract_en: Highlights•Women and high-SES customers face price discrimination; overcharges exceed 3%.•Surcharges for medium/high-SES female customers rise above 6%.•Less robust evidence for discrimination based on prior product knowledge or external financing.•Sellers often oversize system capacity relative to the optimal net present value.•Evidence of discrimination regarding system capacity oversizing is relatively weak.AbstractThis paper presents an empirical analysis of supply-side discrimination in the green technology market, with implications for policy optimization in emerging economies. We conduct an audit experiment using a messenger-based approach to investigate price discrimination and market behaviors in Mexico’s residential distributed solar photovoltaic (DPV) market. By using randomized fictitious customer profiles that vary by gender, socioeconomic status (SES), prior DPV knowledge, and access to external financing, we assess how these factors influence provider responses to quote requests. Our findings indicate that women and medium- to high-SES customers face significant overcharges, with combined surcharges exceeding 6% in some cases. Evidence of discriminatory practices based on product knowledge and access to financing is less robust. Oversizing of capacity by providers relative to the optimal size seems to be a common practice, although evidence of discrimination in this regard is rather weak.Discriminatory practices may reduce the cost-effectiveness and accessibility of DPV systems, ultimately hindering the impact of programs designed to promote green technology adoption. Addressing these biases is essential for improving market efficiency and enhancing the effectiveness of green technology initiatives aimed at promoting broader adoption across diverse populations.
articles.abstract_cn: 亮点•女性和高社会经济地位客户面临价格歧视；超额收费超过3%。•中/高社会经济地位女性客户的附加费上升至6%以上。•基于先前产品知识或外部融资的歧视证据较弱。•卖方经常将系统容量过度配置至超过最优净现值。•关于系统容量过度配置的歧视证据相对较弱。摘要本文对绿色技术市场中的供给侧歧视进行了实证分析，对新兴经济体的政策优化具有启示意义。我们采用基于信使的审计实验方法，调查墨西哥住宅分布式太阳能光伏（DPV）市场中的价格歧视和市场行为。通过使用随机化的虚构客户档案，这些档案在性别、社会经济地位（SES）、先前DPV知识和外部融资获取方面有所不同，我们评估了这些因素如何影响供应商对报价请求的响应。我们的研究结果表明，女性和中高社会经济地位客户面临显著的超额收费，在某些情况下，综合附加费超过6%。基于产品知识和融资获取的歧视性做法证据较弱。供应商相对于最优规模过度配置容量似乎是一种常见做法，尽管这方面的歧视证据相对较弱。歧视性做法可能降低DPV系统的成本效益和可及性，最终阻碍旨在促进绿色技术采用的项目的影响。解决这些偏见对于提高市场效率和增强旨在促进更广泛人群采用绿色技术倡议的有效性至关重要。

articles.title_en: Regular Research ArticleGendered networks and demand for an agricultural technology in India
articles.title_cn: 常规研究文章：性别化网络与印度农业技术需求
articles.abstract_en: Highlights•Women and men access distinct agricultural information networks.•The effect of women’s and men’s networks on household’s technology demand differs.•Women may have access to information, but it may not be valued within households.•Studying social learning in heads’ networks may miss how households make decisions.AbstractStudies on social learning and technology adoption often only consider the networks of a single individual in a household as a source of information influencing agricultural production decisions. We test the validity of this assumption by examining the role of men’s and women’s social networks in the adoption of a novel water-saving technology, laser land leveling (LLL), in India. Using network data from men and women in the same household, we test the influence of being connected to an adopter on demand for LLL. We identify the causal gender-specific network effects using a field experiment that combines an auction with a lottery for the technology, making the presence of adopters in networks exogenous. The data reveal that men’s and women’s networks vary in size and show little overlap. We find that whereas household demand for LLL increases when men are linked to an LLL-adopting household, it decreases when the network linkages run through women. These gender-differentiated effects are concentrated in households where the woman’s opinion about the technology is valued by the man and in non-poor households. The results highlight that social learning may interact with the socio-demographic characteristics of households in myriad ways to influence household technology adoption decisions, and that agricultural-based information interventions ought to also consider how information gets used in the household.
articles.abstract_cn: 亮点•女性和男性获取不同的农业信息网络。•女性和男性网络对家庭技术需求的影响不同。•女性可能获得信息，但在家庭内部可能不被重视。•仅研究户主网络中的社会学习可能无法捕捉家庭决策方式。摘要关于社会学习和技术采用的研究通常只考虑家庭中单个个体的网络作为影响农业生产决策的信息来源。我们通过考察印度男性和女性社交网络在采用新型节水技术——激光平地（LLL）中的作用，来检验这一假设的有效性。利用同一家庭中男性和女性的网络数据，我们检验与采用者联系对LLL需求的影响。我们通过结合拍卖和彩票的田间实验，识别出因果性的性别特定网络效应，使网络中采用者的存在成为外生变量。数据显示，男性和女性的网络在规模上存在差异且重叠很少。我们发现，当男性与采用LLL的家庭有联系时，家庭对LLL的需求增加，而当网络联系通过女性时，需求则减少。这些性别差异效应集中在女性对技术的意见被男性重视的家庭以及非贫困家庭中。结果强调，社会学习可能以多种方式与家庭的社会人口特征相互作用，影响家庭技术采用决策，基于农业的信息干预也应考虑信息在家庭内部的使用方式。

articles.title_en: Regular Research ArticleCOVID-19 and rural livelihoods: lessons from a longer-term assessment and the path to recovery
articles.title_cn: 常规研究文章COVID-19与农村生计：长期评估的教训及复苏路径
articles.abstract_en: Highlights•This paper provides a long-term assessment of COVID-19 impacts and post-pandemic recovery dynamics in rural Guatemala.•The analysis uses a four-round longitudinal survey of 1,262 smallholder households from 2019 to 2022.•Food security and dietary diversity improved by mid-2022, though several indicators remained below pre-pandemic levels.•We also observe a sustained increase in migration intentions since 2021, with levels more than twice those reported in 2019.•For a household subsample, estimates show average income declines alongside rising expenditure and indebtedness.AbstractThe COVID-19 pandemic had profound effects on livelihoods across rural populations worldwide. Building on earlier work that examined the initial effects of the pandemic on food security and nutrition among smallholder agricultural households in the Western Highlands of Guatemala, this study offers a longer-term assessment of the impacts and the path to recovery. We rely on a unique longitudinal survey of 1,262 households conducted over four rounds between 2019 and 2022, with the first round in person and the subsequent ones by phone. The results show substantial recoveries in food security and dietary diversity in the region by mid-2022 compared to 2020, but at levels still worse than pre-pandemic ones for some indicators. There is also a sustained increase in the intention to emigrate. The households that were initially more affected in terms of food security and nutrition but recovered faster include those located in one of the three studied departments and families living above the poverty line, while smallholders affected by hurricanes, non-coffee producers, and indigenous populations took longer to recover. We additionally provide quantitative estimates for a subsample of households interviewed in person during a fifth survey round at the end of 2022, showing an average decline of about 16 percent in total household income three years after the start of the pandemic, mainly driven by a decrease in agricultural income, combined with a 26-percent increase in expenditures and an important surge in indebtedness. Overall, the study offers valuable lessons regarding the recovery of vulnerable households following a major global crisis and in a context of additional shocks.
articles.abstract_cn: 要点•本文对危地马拉农村地区COVID-19的影响及疫情后复苏动态进行了长期评估。•分析使用了从1,262年到2019年对2022个小农户家庭进行的四轮纵向调查。•到2022年中期，粮食安全和膳食多样性有所改善，但若干指标仍低于疫情前水平。•我们还观察到自2021年以来移民意愿持续上升，其水平是2019年报告的两倍多。•对于家庭子样本，估计显示平均收入下降，同时支出和负债上升。摘要COVID-19疫情对全球农村人口的生计产生了深远影响。基于先前研究疫情对危地马拉西部高地小农户农业家庭粮食安全和营养的初步影响的工作，本研究提供了对影响及复苏路径的长期评估。我们依赖于一项独特的纵向调查，该调查在1,262年至2019年间进行了四轮，涉及2022个家庭，第一轮为面对面调查，后续轮次通过电话进行。结果显示，与2022年相比，到2020年中期，该地区的粮食安全和膳食多样性显著恢复，但某些指标仍低于疫情前水平。移民意愿也持续上升。最初在粮食安全和营养方面受影响较大但恢复较快的家庭包括位于三个研究省份之一的家庭和生活在贫困线以上的家庭，而受飓风影响的小农户、非咖啡生产者和土著人群恢复时间较长。我们还为在2022年底第五轮调查中面对面访谈的家庭子样本提供了定量估计，显示疫情开始三年后，家庭总收入平均下降约16%，主要由于农业收入减少，同时支出增加26，负债显著上升。总体而言，该研究为重大全球危机后脆弱家庭的恢复提供了宝贵经验，并考虑了额外冲击的背景。

articles.title_en: Regular Research ArticleGender, Development, and Recognition of Anthropogenic Climate Change
articles.title_cn: 常规研究文章：性别、发展与对人为气候变化的认知
articles.abstract_en: Highlights•Women in less developed countries are less likely than men to recognize climate change as human-caused.•Gender gap in climate knowledge closes as countries advance economically and democratically.•Educational disparities drive gender differences in understanding climate science globally.•Democratic freedoms and information access reduce gender gaps in climate change beliefs.•Study challenges narrative that women are universally more knowledgeable about climate change.AbstractThe impacts of climate change vary significantly across populations, with gender playing a crucial role in shaping how individuals think about and respond to climate risks. Despite evidence that in developed countries women generally express greater environmental concern, this study reveals a critical knowledge gap: women in less economically and democratically developed societies are less likely than men to think climate change is caused by human activities. Using data from 103 countries and territories (n = 92,691), we demonstrate that this gender disparity in thinking about climate causation stems from structural inequalities in access to education and information, particularly in contexts where women’s educational opportunities are limited. As countries advance economically and democratically, these gender gaps in recognizing climate change’s anthropogenic causes diminish. This research highlights how development pathways, particularly educational attainment and information access, shape gendered thinking about climate causation, underscoring the need for gender-responsive climate education initiatives that target women’s specific barriers to climate literacy.
articles.abstract_cn: 亮点•在欠发达国家，女性比男性更不可能认识到气候变化是由人类活动引起的。•随着国家经济与民主的发展，气候知识方面的性别差距逐渐缩小。•教育差距在全球范围内驱动了理解气候科学上的性别差异。•民主自由和信息获取减少了气候变化信念中的性别差距。•研究挑战了女性普遍对气候变化更为了解的说法。摘要气候变化的影响在不同人群中差异显著，性别在塑造个人对气候风险的思考和反应方式中扮演关键角色。尽管有证据表明，在发达国家，女性通常表现出更强的环境关注，但本研究揭示了一个关键的知识差距：在经济和民主发展程度较低的社会中，女性比男性更不可能认为气候变化是由人类活动引起的。利用来自103个国家和地区的数据（n = 92,691），我们证明了这种关于气候变化成因思考的性别差异源于教育和信息获取方面的结构性不平等，尤其是在女性教育机会受限的环境中。随着国家在经济和民主上的进步，这些在认识气候变化人为原因上的性别差距逐渐缩小。本研究强调了发展路径，特别是教育成就和信息获取，如何塑造关于气候成因的性别化思维，并强调了针对女性气候素养特定障碍的性别响应型气候教育倡议的必要性。

articles.title_en: Regular Research ArticleUnveiling Injustice: Analyzing Child Mortality Inequality across decades in Peru (1981–2017)
articles.title_cn: 常规研究文章揭示不公：分析秘鲁数十年间儿童死亡率不平等（1981-2017）
articles.abstract_en: Highlights•Progress hides gaps: Under-5 mortality fell from 117 to 12.8 per 1,000 (1981–2017), yet disparities persist across groups.•Maternal education is the most associated factor with child mortality inequality, and it has risen over time.•Rural and regional gaps have narrowed: Inequality by geography has declined but remains substantial, with rural children still facing an elevated mortality risk.•Intersectional matters: Indigenous, poor, rural children face 5–8 times higher mortality risk than the opposite group.•Structural inequality persists: group mortality gaps stayed stable despite overall improvements.AbstractPeru is a developing country that has significantly improved the average of almost all health indicators. Specifically, in the past four decades, child mortality decreased tenfold. However, the same is not necessarily true of equality, which remains a challenge. Using microdata from Peru’s population censuses in 1981, 1993, 2007, and 2017, we estimate the inequality in child mortality across different social groups. We estimate differences between ethnic groups, education levels, wealth quintiles, regions, and urban–rural groups and find that although inequality has decreased, it remains significantly high. The data show that inequality in child mortality increased between 1981 and 1993, declined between 1993 and 2007, and then increased between 2007 and 2017. Differences in education are the most crucial factor, associated with 45 % of the inequality in 1981 and 58 % in 2017. Differences between Lima and rural areas account for 27 % to 30 % of the inequality, while ethnicity contributes only 6 % in 1981 and 10 % in 2017.
articles.abstract_cn: 亮点•进步掩盖差距：5岁以下儿童死亡率从每1,000名中的117例降至12.8例（1981-2017），但各群体间差异依然存在。•母亲教育与儿童死亡率不平等关联最强，且其影响随时间上升。•城乡和地区差距缩小：地理因素导致的不平等有所下降但仍显著，农村儿童仍面临更高的死亡风险。•交叉因素重要：土著、贫困、农村儿童面临的死亡风险比相反群体高5-8倍。•结构性不平等持续：尽管整体改善，群体间死亡率差距保持稳定。摘要秘鲁是一个发展中国家，几乎所有健康指标的平均水平都有显著提高。具体而言，在过去四十年中，儿童死亡率下降了十倍。然而，平等情况未必如此，这仍是一个挑战。利用秘鲁1981年、1993年、2007年和2017年人口普查的微观数据，我们估计了不同社会群体间儿童死亡率的不平等。我们估计了民族群体、教育水平、财富五分位、地区和城乡群体之间的差异，发现尽管不平等有所下降，但仍显著偏高。数据显示，儿童死亡率不平等在1981年至1993年间上升，1993年至2007年间下降，然后在2007年至2017年间再次上升。教育差异是最关键的因素，与1981年45%和2017年58%的不平等相关。利马与农村地区之间的差异占不平等的27%至30%，而民族因素在1981年仅贡献6%，在2017年贡献10%。

articles.title_en: Regular Research ArticleClimate change impacts on commodity price stability through changing ENSO patterns
articles.title_cn: 常规研究文章气候变化通过改变ENSO模式对商品价格稳定性的影响
articles.abstract_en: Highlights•We propose a novel GFALP model to isolate the global transmission of ENSO shocks on commodity markets, accounting for macroeconomic conditions.•Unanticipated ENSO movements asymmetrically impact commodity price volatility, with distinct effects during El Niño and La Niña periods.•Climate change may alter ENSO frequency and intensity, exacerbating commodity price instability through non-linear effects.•We introduce an index quantifying commodity price exposure to ENSO-related climate disruptions, revealing heterogeneous vulnerabilities.•Commodity price volatility that could result from climate change is found to be amplified by financialization, production concentration, and limited global market participation.AbstractClimate change is a global phenomenon that has a significant impact on commodity prices. This paper analyzes the impact of El Niño–Southern Oscillation (ENSO) on global commodity prices, using a Global Factor Local Projections (GFALP) model. Firstly, we demonstrate that unanticipated ENSO movements contribute to commodity price volatility asymmetrically during El Niño and La Niña periods. Secondly, climate change might disrupt ENSO patterns. We compare the current situation with potential climate change outcomes to evaluate its impact on commodity price stability. We compute an index measuring commodity price exposure to these disruptions. We demonstrate that in most cases, these shifts exacerbate commodity price volatility. Finally, we explore several avenues to explain the observed heterogeneity in the exposure of commodity prices to the evolution of ENSO that could result from climate change, and we highlight the crucial role of international commodity markets in adapting to climate change.
articles.abstract_cn: 亮点•我们提出了一种新颖的GFALP模型，以隔离ENSO冲击对商品市场的全球传导，同时考虑宏观经济条件。•未预期的ENSO变动对商品价格波动性产生不对称影响，在厄尔尼诺和拉尼娜期间具有不同的效应。•气候变化可能改变ENSO的频率和强度，通过非线性效应加剧商品价格不稳定。•我们引入了一个指数，量化商品价格对ENSO相关气候干扰的暴露程度，揭示出异质性的脆弱性。•发现可能由气候变化导致的商品价格波动性会被金融化、生产集中度和有限的全球市场参与所放大。摘要气候变化是一个全球现象，对商品价格有显著影响。本文使用全球因子局部投影（GFALP）模型，分析了厄尔尼诺-南方涛动（ENSO）对全球商品价格的影响。首先，我们证明未预期的ENSO变动在厄尔尼诺和拉尼娜期间对商品价格波动性产生不对称影响。其次，气候变化可能扰乱ENSO模式。我们将当前情况与潜在的气候变化结果进行比较，以评估其对商品价格稳定性的影响。我们计算了一个衡量商品价格对这些干扰暴露程度的指数。我们证明在大多数情况下，这些变化加剧了商品价格波动性。最后，我们探讨了几种途径来解释商品价格对可能由气候变化导致的ENSO演变暴露程度中观察到的异质性，并强调了国际商品市场在适应气候变化中的关键作用。

articles.title_en: Regular Research ArticleUnpaid care work for the elderly in Thailand: does the social gender norm on altruistic behavior matter?
articles.title_cn: 常规研究文章泰国老年人无偿照护工作：关于利他行为的社会性别规范是否重要？
articles.abstract_en: Highlights•Thai women play a central role in providing informal elderly care within households, and gender unpaid care gaps are evident.•A novel Altruistic Time Ratio is constructed using national time-use data, showing women are more altruistic than men.•The Social Gender Norm (SGN) reveals regional and rural/urban disparities in social expectations.•The SGN affects caregiving time for women and men in opposite ways, mainly viaa direct channel, widening the gender care gap.•Trade-offs between paid work and leisure are strong across genders but the only women significantly swap work for caregiving.AbstractAgeing societies pose an increasing demand for elderly care, particularly in developing countries where formal long-term care infrastructure remains underdeveloped. In these contexts, unpaid family caregivers, especially women, play a crucial role. However, gender care gaps shaped by prevailing social gender norms are seldom quantified, and the underlying factors behind these gaps remain underexplored in the literature. This paper investigates gender differences in elderly caregiving and examines how social gender norms influence caregiving patterns. Using nationally representative Thai time-use data from 2014 to 15 and the Labor Force Survey from 2013 to 15, we address two main questions (i) How does the social gender norm around altruism affect the gender care gap for the elderly, directly or indirectly, and through which channels? and (ii) How do men and women trade off care burdens with paid work or leisure time? We contribute to the body of literature on unpaid care work by analyzing the gender differentials in trade-offs associated with elder caregiving as both main and secondary activities. We develop a novel altruistic time ratio (ATR), defined as the time individuals allocate to others relative to time spent on themselves. We quantify the social gender norm (SGN) as the gender mean difference in ATRs, aggregated at the district-area level. The wide variation of SGN across Thai regions offers a broader societal perspective beyond individual and household characteristics in understanding caregiving behavior. Our findings, derived from single and multi-equation Tobit models, reveal that (i) SGN increases elderly care time for women by inducing their ATR while reducing it for men and (ii) significant trade-offs exist between elderly care time, leisure time, and paid work. These results provide empirical evidence on how social expectations shape caregiving behaviors and underscore the importance of recognizing societal influences when designing policies that support equitable elder care arrangements beyond state-provided long-term care.
articles.abstract_cn: 亮点•泰国女性在家庭内提供非正式老年人照护方面发挥核心作用，且性别无偿照护差距明显。•利用全国时间使用数据构建了一个新颖的利他时间比率，显示女性比男性更具利他性。•社会性别规范揭示了社会期望在区域和城乡之间的差异。•社会性别规范对女性和男性的照护时间产生相反方向的影响，主要通过直接渠道，扩大了性别照护差距。•有偿工作与休闲之间的权衡在性别间都很强烈，但只有女性显著地将工作转换为照护。摘要老龄化社会对老年人照护的需求日益增加，尤其是在正式长期照护基础设施尚不发达的发展中国家。在这些背景下，无偿家庭照护者，尤其是女性，发挥着至关重要的作用。然而，由主流社会性别规范塑造的性别照护差距很少被量化，且这些差距背后的潜在因素在文献中仍未得到充分探讨。本文研究了老年人照护中的性别差异，并考察了社会性别规范如何影响照护模式。利用2014年至15年具有全国代表性的泰国时间使用数据以及2013年至15年的劳动力调查数据，我们解决两个主要问题：（i）围绕利他主义的社会性别规范如何直接或间接地影响老年人照护的性别差距，并通过哪些渠道？（ii）男性和女性如何在照护负担与有偿工作或休闲时间之间进行权衡？我们通过分析作为主要和次要活动的老年人照护相关权衡中的性别差异，为无偿照护工作文献做出贡献。我们开发了一个新颖的利他时间比率（ATR），定义为个人分配给他人的时间相对于花在自己身上的时间。我们将社会性别规范（SGN）量化为ATR的性别均值差异，并在地区层面进行汇总。泰国各地区SGN的广泛差异为理解照护行为提供了超越个人和家庭特征的更广泛社会视角。我们的研究结果来自单一和多重方程Tobit模型，揭示：（i）SGN通过提高女性的ATR增加了她们的老年人照护时间，同时减少了男性的照护时间；（ii）老年人照护时间、休闲时间和有偿工作之间存在显著的权衡。这些结果为社会期望如何塑造照护行为提供了经验证据，并强调了在制定支持公平老年人照护安排的政策时，认识到社会影响的重要性，而不仅仅依赖国家提供的长期照护。

articles.title_en: Regular Research ArticleCrop commercialization, structural change and income inequality: Insights from smallholder farmers in rural Southeast Asia
articles.title_cn: 常规研究文章作物商业化、结构变迁与收入不平等：来自东南亚农村小农户的见解
articles.abstract_en: Highlights•Structural change in agriculture plays an important role in the economic development of developing countries.•Crop commercialization has a positive correlation with the structural change.•An increase in commercialization can reduce income inequality in relative terms.•Policies on facilitating crop commercialization and supporting mechanization are suggested.AbstractStructural change in agriculture is an integral part of economic development in developing economies. The process of structural change is accompanied by adjustments within and outside agriculture, such as the development of mechanization and the shift to non-farm employment. We examine the correlations of crop commercialization with structural change and assess how the benefits of crop commercialization are distributed across farm and total income quantiles. We use a balanced panel of 2,867 rural smallholder farmers collected from Thailand and Vietnam, two middle-income countries in Southeast Asia for empirical analyses. Our panel includes three survey waves conducted in 2010, 2013, and 2016 with a total of 8,601 observations. Regarding the correlation of crop commercialization with structural change, our simultaneous equation model results show that crop commercialization is positively related to crop mechanization. The results of fixed-effects estimation with a control function approach indicate that an increase in crop commercialization has a positive correlation with non-farm employment. Besides, the results of unconditional quantile regression models suggest that an increase in crop commercialization leads to an increase of about 25.4% and 5.6% in per capita farm income of smallholders in the 10th and 25th quantile groups, while it increases the per capita total income of smallholders in the 10th and 25th quantile groups by about 10.2% and 5.7%, respectively. Hence, we recommend facilitating the commercialization of crops by smallholder farmers to stimulate the structural transformation of agriculture at the micro level and to reduce income inequality of smallholder farmers.
articles.abstract_cn: 亮点•农业结构变迁在发展中国家经济发展中扮演重要角色。•作物商业化与结构变迁呈正相关。•商业化的增加可以在相对意义上减少收入不平等。•建议制定促进作物商业化和支持机械化的政策。摘要农业结构变迁是发展中经济体经济发展的重要组成部分。结构变迁过程伴随着农业内外部的调整，如机械化的发展和向非农就业的转变。我们考察了作物商业化与结构变迁的相关性，并评估了作物商业化的收益如何在农场收入和总收入分位数之间分配。我们使用了来自泰国和越南（东南亚两个中等收入国家）的2,867名农村小农户的平衡面板数据进行实证分析。我们的面板包括在2010、2013和2016年进行的三轮调查，共8,601个观测值。关于作物商业化与结构变迁的相关性，我们的联立方程模型结果显示，作物商业化与作物机械化呈正相关。采用控制函数方法的固定效应估计结果表明，作物商业化的增加与非农就业呈正相关。此外，无条件分位数回归模型的结果表明，作物商业化的增加导致小农户在10和25分位数组的人均农场收入增加约25.4%和5.6%，而分别使10和25分位数组的小农户人均总收入增加约10.2%和5.7%。因此，我们建议促进小农户的作物商业化，以在微观层面刺激农业的结构转型，并减少小农户的收入不平等。

articles.title_en: Regular Research ArticleMicrowork as a development project: An ethnographic study of data annotators in Guizhou, China
articles.title_cn: 常规研究文章微型工作作为发展项目：中国贵州数据标注员的民族志研究
articles.abstract_en: Highlights•This paper examines how microwork is promoted as a development project in one of the poorest regions in China.•In addition to platform, local outsourced agencies participated in skills training and labor supervision.•Development studies need to take into consideration the central role of labor as an agency for change.AbstractThis paper adopts an ethnographic approach to explore microwork as a development project, focusing on the dynamic relations between the state, labor recruiting agency and workers. The Chinese state has made big investments to turn the poor and remote region of Guizhou into a big data hub, laying high hopes for high-tech to contribute to poverty alleviation. Soon the big data industry attracted the concentration of data annotation firms that vowed to train unskilled rural residents to work. We present the case of G Firm, a “complementary organizations to algorithms” (COTA) that conducts data annotation for AI platforms and meets the government’s demand for job creation. Conventional research on microwork largely focuses on how platforms such as AMT and Clickfarm exploit labor, but has paid little attention to the role of outsourced agencies in taking up the tasks of labor training and management. This paper looks at how G Firm offered a space of worker copresence to facilitate the social learning of labelling skills. However, whether annotation work is qualified or not is decided less on annotator’s individual embodied experience or peers’ social expertise than on the requirement of the inspectors. Therefore, COTA serves as an intermediary for the coding elites to exert indirect control over the cybertariat who often have to endure unpaid work due to the fast iteration process of AI. However, the fast turnover rate and fragmented division of labor made them difficult to build solidarity and assert better labor rights. Although data annotators can accomplish tasks that algorithms fail to do, given their lack of solidarity, their skills have not endowed them with high bargaining power. Our study has demonstrated the indispensable role of human labor to technological growth and would like to call for development studies to take into consideration the central role of labor as an agency for change.
articles.abstract_cn: 亮点•本文探讨了微型工作如何在中国最贫困地区之一被推广为发展项目。•除平台外，本地外包机构参与了技能培训和劳动监督。•发展研究需要考虑劳动作为变革动力的核心作用。摘要本文采用民族志方法探讨微型工作作为发展项目，重点关注国家、劳动力招聘机构与工人之间的动态关系。中国政府已投入巨资将贫困偏远的贵州地区转变为大数据中心，寄厚望于高科技助力扶贫。不久，大数据产业吸引了数据标注公司的聚集，这些公司承诺培训无技能的农村居民就业。我们以G公司为例，这是一家“算法的补充组织”（COTA），为AI平台进行数据标注，并满足政府创造就业的需求。关于微型工作的传统研究主要关注AMT和Clickfarm等平台如何剥削劳动力，但很少关注外包机构在承担劳动力培训和管理任务中的作用。本文考察了G公司如何提供工人共处空间以促进标注技能的社会学习。然而，标注工作是否合格更多取决于检查员的要求，而非标注员个人的具身体验或同伴的社会专业知识。因此，COTA作为编码精英对网络无产阶级实施间接控制的中介，后者常因AI快速迭代过程而不得不忍受无薪工作。然而，高流动率和碎片化的劳动分工使他们难以建立团结并争取更好的劳动权益。尽管数据标注员能完成算法无法完成的任务，但由于缺乏团结，他们的技能并未赋予他们较高的议价能力。我们的研究证明了人类劳动对技术增长不可或缺的作用，并呼吁发展研究考虑劳动作为变革动力的核心作用。

articles.title_en: Regular Research ArticleEchoes of colonial disruption: historicizing vulnerability, raiding, and violence in Northwestern Kenya
articles.title_cn: 常规研究文章殖民扰动的回响：肯尼亚西北部脆弱性、劫掠与暴力的历史化
articles.abstract_en: Highlights•The British conquest of the Turkana in the 1910s devastated the pastoral economy.•Colonial livestock theft and border enforcement made the Turkana vulnerable to environmental fluctuations.•In the colonial era, ecological conditions became the primary driver of conflict between the Turkana and neighboring groups.•The droughts in 1928 and 1933 mark the beginning of new conflict dynamics in Turkana.•The vulnerability and insecurity experienced in contemporary Turkana are legacies of colonial policies.
articles.abstract_cn: 要点•1910年英国对图尔卡纳的征服摧毁了牧区经济。•殖民时期的牲畜盗窃和边境管制使图尔卡纳人易受环境波动影响。•在殖民时代，生态条件成为图尔卡纳人与邻近群体冲突的主要驱动因素。•1928年和1933年的干旱标志着图尔卡纳冲突动态的新开端。•当代图尔卡纳所经历的脆弱性和不安全感是殖民政策的遗留影响。
